items.title: Hackathon All-in-One Platform
items.description: An all-in-one platform for running hackathons end to end, from planning to the awards wrap-up. It runs multiple events in a single system, with a landing page per event plus dedicated screens for the operations console, participating teams, judges, and mentors. Features include team applications, team assignment, pre-issued access-code authentication, deliverable submission, judge scoring with AI-generated judging questions via Amazon Bedrock, mentoring booking and notes (with Word export), and on-site tools such as a live board and draws. Built as a Turborepo monorepo separating the landing site from the app, deployed with PostgreSQL to AWS Lightsail via GitHub Actions, and used to run the Honam, Gwangju University, Chonnam National University, and Northeast Region hackathons.

items.title: Integrated Metering Platform
items.description: An AMI (advanced metering infrastructure) platform for high-voltage remote metering. It monitors status, performance, and load-profile (LP) data collected from wireless modems and power meters, sends manual commands over FEP TCP sockets, and manages firmware OTA upgrades. Built on the eGovFrame 4.0 / Spring MVC stack with role-by-menu access control, a Chart.js dashboard, and Excel export, deployed to an on-premise server via Docker and GitHub Actions.

items.title: Labit
items.description: The backend and admin dashboard for an interactive science-learning service (chemistry bonding) for middle-school students. Built an async FastAPI backend for learning-content and quiz APIs with OpenAI-based quiz feedback, plus JWT authentication with Argon2 hashing, Cloudflare R2 image uploads, and Alembic migrations. The admin console manages content and users with React and Ant Design, deployed on Railway and Vercel.

items.title: Nanaly
items.description: The backend and landing page for a mobile app that manages per-store staff schedules — shifts, time-off, notices, and push notifications. The NestJS backend provides JWT and Google/Apple social login, store-level RBAC (owner/manager/staff), shift-reminder cron jobs, Expo push, and AWS SES email, deployed on Railway and EC2. The landing page collects pre-registration leads with Next.js and Tailwind.

items.title: JangsaGuide
items.description: The backend for an AI-powered business-decision solution for small business owners. It analyzes EZPOS POS Excel sales data and provides profit-and-loss reports and OpenAI-based AI management insights. Built with NestJS — OAuth authentication, refresh-token rotation, deterministic P&L calculation, and Cloudflare R2 file uploads.

items.title: TRANA
items.description: A safe-transaction infrastructure for high-value, high-risk C2C secondhand trades. It combines PASS carrier identity verification, electronic contract signing, a trust-score system, and legal evidence preservation into one standardized flow. Built full-stack with a Kotlin/Spring Boot backend and a Next.js monorepo for the auth and landing web.
